name: iteris
description: Codex plugin for the portable Iteris operator/runtime workflow with `iteris-math` as the merged master skill.

interface.shortDescription: Portable operator/runtime skills centered on the merged `iteris-math` master skill.
interface.longDescription: Iteris distills the Iteris operator/runtime workflow into Codex skills, subagents, and Python helper scripts that operate on repo-local workflow state. The merged `iteris-math` skill is the master operator/runtime layer, while companion subagents handle frontier exploration, task execution, verification, curation, generalization, and reporting.
defaultPrompt: Use $iteris-math to run the canonical portable Iteris operator/runtime loop on this repo.
Use the plugin-owned subagents to explore, execute, curate, generalize, report, and verify against repo-local state.
Rely on the standalone Python helpers under plugins/iteris/scripts for deterministic workflow state operations.
